info.title: glim.sh
info.description: One remote endpoint gives your agent live data from Twitter, Reddit, the open web, GitHub and more. No API keys, no scraping stack - just connect the URL and pay per call.
info.x-guidance: glim.sh is a pay-per-use research and inference API. Every /api/v1 endpoint accepts an x402 or MPP wallet payment, or a glim.sh API key / OAuth token (apiKey query param or Authorization: Bearer <key>) charged to your account. The MCP server at /mcp accepts the same credential types.

post.summary: Search tweets with advanced query operators
post.description: Search Twitter with advanced operators. Returns ~20 tweets per page with engagement summary. Use cursor for pagination.

sort.description: Sort order: "latest" (newest first) or "top" (most engaged). Default: "latest".

start_date.description: Only tweets on or after this time. YYYY-MM-DD (UTC midnight) or ISO 8601 datetime with Z/offset (e.g. 2026-04-13T14:30:00Z)

end_date.description: Only tweets before this time. YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive through end of day UTC) or ISO 8601 datetime with Z/offset (e.g. 2026-04-13T14:30:00Z)

expand_urls.description: When true, auto-crawl entity URLs and attach crawled_content to tweets. Off by default: responses can grow by up to 4KB per expanded URL. Use glim_web_crawl(url) for targeted crawls instead.

x-payment-info.description: Search tweets with advanced query operators

post.summary: Fetch a tweet with thread context, or a user profile
post.description: Fetch a tweet or a user from a single reference. Tweet URLs, handle-less /i/status URLs, and bare numeric tweet ids return the tweet with full thread context, parent, and optional replies/quotes; a profile URL (https://x.com/<handle>) returns the user with ~20 recent tweets.

ref.description: Tweet URL/id or profile URL. Tweet URLs including /i/status/<id> and bare numeric tweet ids return the tweet + thread; a profile URL (https://x.com/<handle>) returns the user + recent tweets.

include.description: Tweet refs only: extra sections to include (replies, quotes)

include_replies.description: Profile refs only: include replies in the timeline

include_mentions.description: Profile refs only: include the mentions timeline

expand_urls.description: When true, auto-crawl entity URLs and attach crawled_content to tweets. Off by default: responses can grow by up to 4KB per expanded URL. Use glim_web_crawl(url) for targeted crawls instead.

x-payment-info.description: Fetch a tweet with thread context, or a user profile

post.summary: Run a semantic web search with ranked results
post.description: Semantic web search powered by Exa. Returns titles, URLs, and a query-relevant excerpt per result.

exclude_domains.description: Exclude results from these domains. Useful for filtering noisy aggregators or SEO farms when you've seen them dominate results (e.g. ['pinterest.com', 'quora.com']).

published_within_days.description: Restrict to results published within the last N days. Skip this for broad queries - it excludes pages without publish-date metadata. Common values: 1, 7, 30, 365.

x-payment-info.description: Run a semantic web search with ranked results

post.summary: Fetch a web page as clean extracted content
post.description: Extract content from a web page as markdown, HTML, or JSON.

outcome.description: Classified result type. Use this to branch your retry / strategy logic.

paywalled.description: True when the URL is paywalled. Equivalent to outcome === 'paywall'.

unsupported_reason.description: When outcome=unsupported_target, why the URL pattern is permanently unsupported.

alternatives.description: When outcome=unsupported_target, alternative URL patterns or tools that may work.

total_chars.description: Full extracted content length in characters, before any inline truncation.

truncated.description: True when content was truncated to fit the inline cap; full content at download_url.

truncated_chars.description: Characters NOT included inline (available via download_url).

download_url.description: Presigned HTTPS URL to download the full extracted content. Set when truncated.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when download_url expires (~1h).

format.description: Output format. 'markdown' (default) clean article text; 'html' raw cleaned HTML; 'json' the structured SSR blob (TikTok, Pinterest, etc.) instead of article text.

x-payment-info.description: Fetch a web page as clean extracted content

post.summary: Search GitHub repos, conversations, or code
post.description: Search GitHub repositories, conversations (issues + PRs), or code. Supports GitHub search syntax.

query.description: Search query. For kind=repos: minimal distinctive keywords only - the project/library name (GOOD: 'rtk', 'react query'; BAD: natural-language phrases like 'rtk rust token killer', which match copycat repos and exclude the real project). Narrow with qualifiers (language:, stars:>N, topic:, user:/org:, in:readme), not extra words. For kind=code: a LITERAL code pattern that appears in files (GOOD: 'useState(', 'createServerFn'; BAD: keywords/questions); narrow with the repo param or language:/path: qualifiers in the query (e.g. 'split_payment language:rust path:src/', extracted automatically), not extra words. Supports full GitHub search syntax.

kind.description: What to search: 'repos', 'conversations' (issues+PRs), or 'code' (literal code patterns across 1M+ public GitHub repos). Optional - if omitted it is inferred from the query (a repo: scope or is:/label: qualifier implies conversations; a path: qualifier implies code; otherwise repos).

repo.description: Scope to one repository. Accepts 'owner/name', a github.com URL, or a partial 'owner/' (code). Works with any kind; setting it with kind=repos routes the search to conversations, since repo-name search can't scope to one repo.

sort.description: Sort field. Repos: stars, forks, updated, help-wanted-issues. Conversations: comments, reactions, interactions, created, updated. Default: best-match (relevance)

x-payment-info.description: Search GitHub repos, conversations, or code

post.summary: Fetch GitHub repo metadata, files, PRs, or issues
post.description: Fetch GitHub data from a single ref (a github.com URL or owner/repo shorthand): repo metadata + README, files, tree, commits, branches, releases, PRs, or issues - inferred from the ref.

ref.description: GitHub URL or 'owner/repo' shorthand. A repo URL or owner/repo returns metadata + README; /pull/N -> PR (with comments + changed files), /issues/N -> issue, /blob/<ref>/<path> -> file, /tree/<ref> -> file tree, /commits -> history, /branches, /releases.

x-payment-info.description: Fetch GitHub repo metadata, files, PRs, or issues

post.summary: Search Amazon product listings
post.description: Search Amazon by keyword (query) or browse bestsellers by category (category_slug). Regional TLDs: com, co.uk, de, fr, es, it. Returns ranked products with VAT-exclusive net price computed alongside gross.

query.description: Free-text keyword query (mutually exclusive with category_slug)

category_slug.description: Amazon bestsellers category slug, e.g. 'electronics' (.com), 'elektronik' (.de), 'electronique' (.fr). Invalid slugs return 'not_found' - retry with a correct slug.

tld.description: Amazon marketplace: com | co.uk | de | fr | es | it

response_format.description: 'concise' drops images/variants/deep seller metadata; 'detailed' keeps everything

geo.description: Postal code Amazon uses to compute shipping & delivery dates (e.g. '28001' for Madrid)

sort_by.description: Server-side sort, except 'most_reviewed' which re-ranks the current page client-side by review count desc (rating tiebreaker). Pair 'most_reviewed' with min_reviews to skip thinly-reviewed items.

min_reviews.description: Drop hits with fewer than N reviews. Pair with sort_by='most_reviewed' for a trust-weighted result. Applied client-side to organic/paid/suggested.

category.description: Amazon node ID to narrow results (returned in `refinements` from a prior call)

merchant.description: Filter to a specific seller ID

currency.description: Override display currency. Validated against per-tld allow-list.

include_suggested.description: Include 'people also searched for' suggestions (default: dropped)

x-payment-info.description: Search Amazon product listings

post.summary: Fetch Amazon product details by ASIN
post.description: Fetch live product detail by 10-char ASIN on a regional marketplace (com, co.uk, de, fr, es, it). Runs 2 upstream calls in parallel (amazon_product + amazon_pricing), returning buybox + full offer listing (including used-condition breakdown) + embedded top reviews.

asin.description: 10-char Amazon product ID (ASIN). Obtain a real ASIN from glim_amazon_search results; do not invent or reuse example ASINs.

tld.description: Amazon marketplace: com | co.uk | de | fr | es | it

response_format.description: 'concise' drops images/variants/deep seller metadata; 'detailed' keeps everything

geo.description: Postal code for region-accurate pricing and delivery dates

currency.description: Override display currency. Validated against per-tld allow-list.

schema.description: Fetch live Amazon product detail by ASIN on a specific TLD. Runs 2 upstream calls (amazon_product + amazon_pricing) in parallel and merges buybox + full offer listing.

x-payment-info.description: Fetch Amazon product details by ASIN

post.summary: Fetch YouTube subtitles (VTT file via presigned URL)
post.description: Fetch YouTube subtitles/transcript for an 11-char video_id in the requested language and origin (uploader_provided | auto_generated). Returns a presigned download URL to a WebVTT file (transcripts can be 50K+ chars, so file delivery instead of inline text). URL expires in ~1 hour; call again to refresh. Cached 7 days server-side — repeat calls on the same (video_id, language_code, origin) tuple are free after the first.

200.description: Subtitles available via presigned download URL

origin.description: 'uploader_provided' for human captions (default), 'auto_generated' for YouTube auto-captions.

format.description: 'inline' (default): include vtt in response when transcript fits the inline cap; otherwise omit it and set vtt_omitted_reason. 'url': never include vtt; caller fetches download_url. download_url is always present.

x-payment-info.description: Fetch YouTube subtitles (VTT file via presigned URL)
